rule.collection: same training and observation functions as calibration; clean data, fixed rank 8, fixed lr 1e-4, 400 updates, original probes and generation schedule
rule.consensus_definition: mean of the two ascending average-tie ranks, computed separately within each calibration seed

decision.basis: prospective practical criterion for this descriptive pilot, not a p-value or a universal scientific threshold
decision.not_replicated: complete comparable run and rho < 0.5; applies only to this frozen criterion and run
decision.primary: Spearman correlation of frozen consensus scores and the 32 test-run median absolute changes
decision.unassessable: incomplete run, failed integrity/comparability checks, or undefined correlation

diagnostics_only: overlap between frozen eight examples and the eight smallest test values
ratio of selected median variation to all-example median variation
Spearman correlation between calibration loss-level ranks and test variation; checks whether simple low loss explains the pattern
limitations: single healthy trajectory; no population false-alarm estimate
absolute variation may track loss level; no demonstrated sensor sensitivity
typical variation is not a bound on rare spikes
no controller efficacy claim, no fluid claim
generation outcomes are archived for collection continuity, not analyzed for recovery in this test
rule.question: Does the between-example ordering of typical absolute loss variation transfer from healthy seeds 103/106 to healthy seed 104?
rule.scope_change: 104 is now used only for stability replication. No recovery predictor is frozen or validated; subsequent designs based on its observed outcomes cannot call 104 an unseen holdout.
